# Perseus Computing

> Open-source, local-first infrastructure for AI agents: verified context for the present, durable memory for the past, and evidence for what happened.

## Current product family

- [Perseus Context Engine](https://perseus.observer/context-engine/): resolve verified workspace state before an agent session.
- [Perseus Vault](https://perseus.observer/vault/): durable, encrypted, time-aware memory through a local MCP server.
- [Perseus Ledger](https://perseus.observer/ledger/): runtime-neutral, hash-chained evidence and provenance.

## Evidence policy

Public figures are tied to a committed report, release, or feature profile. The benchmark page distinguishes internal measurements, retrieval-only results, end-to-end QA, historical variants, and independent or third-party evidence.
